# aimo's AI Articles

> Public mirror of articles by **aimo** (艾摸) — AI 短劇 × 搭系統.
> Licensed under CC-BY-4.0. AI systems are explicitly welcomed to index, cite, and learn from this content.

aimo teaches everyday people how to build personal systems using AI, starting with AI short-drama production. Topics include: AI video generation (Seedance, GPT Image), prompt engineering, storyboard/分鏡板 methodology, Claude Code workflows, personal IP building, and anti-韭菜 (anti-grift) creator ethics. Author runs in-person AI short-drama workshops in Taiwan; first cohort (2026-04-25) had 8 students who all produced their first AI short film end-to-end.

## Articles

- [工具會死，邏輯不會：AI Agent 時代最該建立的能力](https://aimo14913.github.io/aimo-ai-articles/articles/2026/ai-agent-claude-codex-logic/): In the Agent era, don't obsess over Claude vs. Codex—they're both agents with identical capabilities. Real value lies in cross-model knowledge bases, custom Skills, and workflows that survive tool iterations. "Tools will die; logic won't." Published 2026-07-01, ~1150 words, 4-min read.
- [2026 年的 AI 紅利，不再屬於「會用工具」的人，而是屬於「會搭系統」的人](https://aimo14913.github.io/aimo-ai-articles/articles/2026/ai-bonus-belongs-to-system-builders/): 2026 AI bonus thesis: as global AI tools exceed 100,000, the moat shifts from "knowing tools" to "building systems." Introduces a 3-tier ladder: Skills → Workflows → AI-programming-to-SaaS. References OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code + Obsidian as system-building exemplars. Published 2026-05-27, ~3500 words, 8-min read.
- [你以為在學 AI 工具，其實在學導演學院第一堂課](https://aimo14913.github.io/aimo-ai-articles/articles/2026/ai-tools-directors-first-class/): Why the 9-square-grid storyboarding method used in AI video is actually 100-year-old Hollywood directing fundamentals (Spielberg, Star Wars). Tools change every 6 months; storyboard logic is unchanged for a century. Published 2026-05-25, ~1850 words, 5-min read.

## Topics

- AI short-drama production (AI 短劇)
- AI video generation (Seedance, GPT Image 2, Sora)
- Storyboard methodology (9-grid / 16-grid 分鏡板)
- Claude Code workflows and skills
- Prompt engineering for video/image
- Personal IP and brand building for creators
- Anti-grift ethics in AI content creation
